label: Clay dusk
blurb: Warm clay keys at night, with the long-press symbol printed on every letter.
note: THE FIRST SKIN, and deliberately the cheapest one that is still worth having. It fetches NOTHING: no art, no hooked font, an empty manifest — so a session with this skin makes exactly the same requests as a session with no skin, and the privacy promise (every fetch happens when the config arrives, never on a key press) is kept by having nothing to fetch at all. What it adds is paint the keyboard could not do before: the symbol a long press would give, printed small in each letter key's top-right corner; the two home-row nubs typists feel for; one drawn path across the space bar; and a press that lifts instead of only fading. Skins are authored HERE, on the server, and expanded into the key tree config.ts already builds (experience/keyboard/skin.ts). The phone never sees this file, has no skin resolver and has no precedence chain: it ships primitives only.
